target_population: Women aged 25–65; HIV-positive women from age 25 or within 1 year of HIV diagnosis

negative.action: Reassure and schedule rescreening in 3 years.

positive.cryotherapy_action: Lesion eligible for cryotherapy. Treat same day (screen-and-treat). Schedule follow-up in 12 months.
positive.leep_action: Lesion not eligible for cryotherapy (too large or extends into endocervix). Refer for LEEP/LLETZ.

negative.action: Reassure and schedule rescreening in 3 years.

positive.cryotherapy_action: Lesion eligible for cryotherapy. Treat same day (screen-and-treat). Schedule follow-up in 12 months.
positive.leep_action: Lesion not eligible for cryotherapy (too large or extends into endocervix). Refer for LEEP/LLETZ.

negative.action: HPV negative. Rescreening recommended in 5 years.

positive.high_risk_action: HPV 16/18 positive. Refer for colposcopy and biopsy.
positive.other_positive_action: HPV positive (non-16/18). Perform VIA triage. If VIA positive, treat; if VIA negative, rescreening in 12 months.

cryotherapy.description: Ablative treatment using CO2 or N2O to freeze and destroy abnormal tissue.
cryotherapy.eligibility: Lesion size ≤75% of transformation zone; entirely visible; not extending into endocervical canal.

leep.description: Loop Electrosurgical Excision Procedure (LEEP/LLETZ). Excision of transformation zone.
leep.eligibility: Large lesion, endocervical extension, or failed cryotherapy.

referral_cancer_treatment.description: Urgent referral to oncology or cancer treatment centre.

hpv_vaccination.catch_up: Women 15–45 if not previously vaccinated, according to national policy

hiv_positive_specifics.notes: HIV-positive women have higher risk; annual screening recommended.
